ROCKSTAROS / DEVELOPER PREVIEW

A development build
to try on Mac.

A public installer is not available. The current procedure is for a Developer Preview running in a virtual environment on a Mac.

Nothing is written to a physical device

This is neither a finished smartphone OS nor an image for avokado mini hardware.

01 / TARGET

Accepted virtual environment

The current baseline is an Apple silicon Mac, macOS 15.7.4, and Lima 2.2.0. It requires Python 3.11 or later, OpenSSL 3, and at least 10 GiB of free space.

02 / ENGLISH SUMMARY

Verify before running anything

  1. Confirm the release version, SHA-256 hash, and signature.
  2. Run only inside the supported Mac virtual environment.
  3. Validate persistence, safe shutdown, backup, and recovery before keeping important data.
  4. Do not treat the Developer Preview as a physical-device or avokado mini image.

The repository's detailed operational procedure is currently maintained in Japanese. The English release-status page remains the safe starting point for English readers.
